title: Protocol Binary Op-Log Layer
description:
Add a new `protocol` technology: the binary container format for the vcs op-log/command-history, the exact twin of `pack` (which is the binary container for the initial document). Laws: dsl text ⇄️ pack binary (exists); ops text ⇄️ protocol binary (new). Protocol is only the format — serialization, storage, streaming — integrated with pack and vcs, reimplementing nothing from vcs (commands/diffs/inverses/projections/merge/sync stay in vcs/framework). Protocol additionally owns efficient materialization: (pack file, protocol file) -> projection in O(checkpoint + tail).

Blocking prerequisite: the existing `protocol` technology (a Blockly-like strict-list visual editor, schema `protocol.program`) must be renamed to `playbook` first, since it occupies the `protocol/` directory and crate name today.

Full design (approved in plan mode) is at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/we-want-to-create-refactored-harbor.md — read it first for the complete byte-level container format, crate family (protocol_core/format/history/materialize/io, facade protocol, protocol_testkit, protocol_cli), vcs integration surface (DocumentBinaryFiles replacing DocumentPackFiles, set_state_with_projection, CodecRegistry changes, storage backends), hub binary wire redesign (BackboneMessage binary slices + SliceMeta, WIT backbone funcs -> list<u8>), and the wave-based rollout plan (Rename -> Crate family -> vcs integration -> framework/WIT sweep -> hub wire -> ~24-family app sweep -> verification).

Full production scope: streaming, zero-copy, append-only history storage with crash recovery (commit-frame chain, not a footer — the file is live and append-only), checkpoints/snapshots, indexes, sync-range slicing, integrity (crc32c + blake3 chain + optional signatures), redaction, versioning/upcasting, CLI, testkit with law-based assertions and corruption fuzzing, and benchmarks.
summary: Superseded/merged: this ticket's scope (protocol as a format-only binary op-log layer) was subsumed by the concurrently-opened, larger-scope ticket 26/07/27/INTRODUCE-DB-PROTOCOL-COMMAND-LAYER-AND-VCS-SLIMMING, whose CW0 wave amended this ticket's contract.md in place (added protocol_command/protocol_causal/protocol_crdt/protocol_wire, extracting Operation/OperationDiff/OpText/HybridLogicalTimestamp/OpDag semantics from vcs/framework-core into protocol, plus a new db server technology, hub rebuild, and vcs slimming). User explicitly approved adopting this larger merged scope. This ticket's contract.md remains the frozen source of truth for the protocol crate family (now referenced by the other ticket); all further orchestration continues under INTRODUCE-DB-PROTOCOL-COMMAND-LAYER-AND-VCS-SLIMMING per its CW1-CW9 wave plan. This ticket's own Wave R (rename protocol tech -> playbook) was completed and verified prior to the merge; its Wave 1/2/2b/3/4 instruction files are now stale and superseded by CW3-CW9 in the other ticket -- do not follow them.
